Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XV OF 2009
ACT XV OF 2009
BALOCHISTAN SPORTS
BOARD ACT, 2009
An Act to provide for
the establishment of a Sports Board
in the Province
of Balochistan
and the matters ancillary thereto
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary,
3rd November, 2009]
No. PAB/Legis: V(15)/2009.5043, dated 3-11-2009.---The Balochistan
Sports Board Bill, 2009 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on
17th October, 2009 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan
on 24th October, 2009 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas, it is expedient to
establish a Sports Board in the Balochistan;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title, extent and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Balochistan
Sports Board Act, 2009.
(2) It shall extend to whole of the Balochistan.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

Definitions

passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on
17th October, 2009 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan
on 24th October, 2009 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas, it is expedient to
establish a Sports Board in the Balochistan;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
2. Definitions.---In
this Act, unless, there is anything repugnant in the subject or context:--
(a) "Act" means the Balochistan Sports Board Act, 2009;
(b) "Association" means an
association of any sports or games duly registered with the Board;
(c)"Board" means the Board
constituted under section 4 of this Act;
(d) "Bye laws" mean the
bye-laws of any Association;
(e) "Chairman" means the
Chairman of the Board;
(f) "District and City Sports
Committee" means a District and City Sports Committee constituted under
section 15 of this Act established under section 13;
(g) "Club" means a club
organized to promote sports/games and duly registered with a Tehsil Committee, a District Committee or as the case may
be a City Committee;
(h) "Executive Committee" means
the Executive Committee constituted under section 9 of this Act.
(i)
"Fund" means the fund of the District or City Sports Committee or, as
the case may be, the Board established under this Act;
(j) "Government" means the
Government of the Balochistan;
(k) "Member" means a member of
the Board, the Executive Committee, the District City Sports Committee or, as
the case may be Teshil Sports Committee.
(l) ""prescribed"
means prescribed by rules or regulations made under this Act;
(m) "Presiding Officer" means
the Presiding Officer of the Executive Committee, the District or City Sports
Committee or as the case may be Tehsil Sports
Committee.
(n) "Province" means the Balochistan
Province;
(o) "regulation"
means regulation made under this Act;
(p) "rules"
mean the rules made under this Act;
(q) "Secretary" means the ex
officio Secretary of the Board;
(r) "Subordinate Offices" means
Divisional, District and Tehsil Sports Committees in
the Balochistan Province and such other Organizations
and Stadia, the Ayub
Stadium, Gen. Musa Hockey Stadium, International
Tartan Track, International Swimming Pool, Taji Khan
Sports, Complex, Firing Range, Football stadium, Dalbandia,
Football Stadium Pishin and such other sports centres as are under the administrative control or purview
of the Board;
(s) "Tehsil
Committee" means a Sports Committee for a Tehsil;

The Board

on 24th October, 2009 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.

It is hereby enacted as follows:--
3. The Board.---(1) As soon as may be after the
commencement of this Act, there shall be established a Board to be known as the
Balochistan Sports Board.
(2) The Board shall be a body corporate
having perpetual succession and a common seal, with powers, subject to this
Act, to acquire and hold property, both movable and immovable, and may by the said name sue and be sued.
(3) The headquarter
of the Board shall be at Quetta and the Directorate of
Sports Balochistan shall provide secretariat
facilities to the Board.

Composition of the Board

4. Composition of the Board.---(1) The Governor of the Balochistan
shall be the Patron-in-Chief of the Board.
The Board shall consist of:--
1.
Minister Incharge of Sports Government of Balochistan
Chairman
2.
The Secretary,
Government of Balochistan, Environment Sports and
Youth Affairs Department
Vice-Chairman
3.
The Secretary,
Government of Balochistan, Finance Department
Member
4.
The Secretary,
Government of Balochistan, Education Department
Member
5.
Director Sports Balochistan
Member
6.
Three leading
sportsmen of the Balochistan Province
to be nominated by the Board
Member
7.
Two public elected
representatives one male and one female to be nominated by the
Patron-in-Chief of the Board
Member
8.
Two Philanthropists to
be nominated by the Board
Member
9.
Two technical expert
well-versed with the Sports activities to be nominated by the Patron-in-chief
of the Board
Member
(3) The Board may, with the prior
approval of the Government, co-pt such other members on the Board as it
considers necessary for the advancement of sports in the Province.
(4) The tenure of a non-official member
shall be two years.
(5) If the seat of a non-official member
becomes vacant during the term of his office, the vacancy
shall be filled
in the same manner
in which the
person whose place
is being filled
was appointed. The person so appointed shall hold office for the residue
of such term.

5. Removal of a member.---The
Executive Committee may be ordered in writing, remove a non-official member, if
he,
(a) refuses or
fails to discharge or becomes incapable of discharging his duties under this
Act, or
(b) has, in the
opinion of the Board abused his position as member; or
(c) has, without
reasonable cause, absented himself from three consecutive meetings of the
Board; or
(d) has been
convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude.

Powers and Functions of the Board

No. PAB/Legis: V(15)/2009.5043, dated 3-11-2009.---The Balochistan
Sports Board Bill, 2009 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on
17th October, 2009 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan
on 24th October, 2009 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas, it is expedient to
establish a Sports Board in the Balochistan;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
6. Powers and Functions of the Board.---The powers and functions of the Board---
(a) to register
sports associations, hold their elections under the supervision of the Board or
the District Sports Committees or the City Sports Committees or as the case may
be the Tehsil Sports Committees.
(b) to provide extension services to the
in-service personnel in the form of
refresher courses, training and coaching programmes,
seminars, conferences and workshops, etc;
(c) to evolve
policies for the promotion and development of various sports and games in the
Province;
(d) to ensure
establishment of sports complexes at Provincial/District/City/Tehsil Headquarters, permanent training and coaching
centers sports hostels etc., in the Province;
(e) to exercise
administrative and functional control over all the stadia
and play fields in the province, and to ensure their proper maintenance and
utilization;
(f) to ensure
adequate provision of play fields, allied facilities and equipment in the
Province;
(g) to ensure
adequate provision of funds for sports and games in the budget of Local
Government and other institutions and their utilization to the fullest
advantage for promotion and development of sports;
(h) to provide
incentive to prominent sportsmen, promising/deserving players and
organizers/employees by granting reward scholarships/honoraria, etc.;
(i) to arrange production of films and publication of literature
and establish reading facilities for the
promotion and development of sports;
(j) to encourage
and promote formation fo clubs at district level;
(k) to maintain
liaison with all Central/Provincial Government Semi Government,
Departments/Agencies for effective implementation of the polices regarding
promotion and development of sports and games;
(l) to keep
liaison with all Commissioner/Nazims/District
Coordination Officers in the Province to ensure effective functioning of Sports
Committee and Associations for the projection of policies of the Government and
the Board;
(m) to approve
the annual budget of grants-in-aid to registered Association clubs and other
sports organizations in the Province;
(n) to ensure that
grants given are utilized for the purpose and in accordance with the objects
for which these are given;
(o) to arrange
training and coaching programmes;
(p) to ensure mass participation in
sports and games by organizing sports competitions/tournaments in the Province
of International, National, Provincial and District level;
(q) to organize
annual youth competitions of various age groups in different games;
(r) to do
generally all such acts and take all such steps as it considers necessary and
conducive to achieving its aims and objects towards promoting sports activities
in the Province;
(s) to take such
disciplinary action as may be necessary against any Association in the
Province, its office-bearers or members or sportsmen in the interest of the
sports and in order to maintain discipline;
(t) to withhold grant-in-aid to such
associations, clubs and other sports organizations as are funded to be
disregarding or violating the provision of this Act the rules or regulations
made their under or who fail to carry
out the direction
issued by the
Board from time
to time;
(u) to acquire
and dispose of property and generally to enter into

7. Meeting of the Board.---(1) A general meeting of the
Board may be held as and when required but it shall be held at least once a
year. A special meeting may be held to transact any special business of the
Board, when summoned by the Chairman or the Executive Committee, provided that
in the absence of the Chairman, the Vice-Chairman may summon a special meeting.
(2) A general or special meeting shall be
presided over by the Chairman, or in his absence, by
the Vice-Chairman.
(3) One-third of the members of the Board
shall constitute a quorum for meeting of the Board, a fraction being counted as
one.
(4) All decisions in a meeting of the
Board shall be taken by majority of votes. In case of equality of votes, the
Chairman or as the case may be, the Vice-Chairman, shall have a casting vote.

Executive Committee

8. Executive Committee.---(1)
Government may, by a notification in the Official Gazette, constitute an
Executive Committee of the Board, consisting of---
(a)
The Secretary Sports
Department Government of Balochistan
Chairman
(b)
A representative of Finance Department,
Government of Balochistan
Members
(c)
A representative from
Women Sports Association
Member

(2) Three members of the
Executive Committee, including the Presiding Officer shall constitute a quorum
for a meeting.
(3) The Chairman shall call meeting of
the Executive Committee, as and when required and shall preside over the
meeting.
(4) All the decisions of the Executive
Committee shall be taken by majority of votes, in case of equality of votes,
the Chairman shall have a casting vote.

9. Power of the Executive Committee.---(1) The Executive Committee shall be competent to deal
with any matter within the competence of the Board, including the following:
(a) to recommend
the affiliation/registration of the games and associations to the Board;
(b) to ensure that the managing body of
each of the Provincial Games and sports associations functions in the best
interest of that games and in conformity with its constitution and bye-laws;
and
(c) to allocate
funds, grants in-aid and subsidies to the games and Associations registered
with the Board to sportsmen and to sanction expenditure for sports activities,
schemes or sports events of special nature.
(2) After approval of the budget by the
Board, the Executive Committee shall
be competent to
re-appropriate a budgetary allocation.

10. Functions, powers and duties of the
Secretary of the Board.--(1) The Director Sports Balochistan
Province shall be ex officio Secretary of the Board.
He shall be provided the permanent
Secretariat for Board.
(2) The Director Sports in his capacity
as Secretary of the Board, shall--
(a) sanction all
expenditure as provided in the budget of the Board;
(b) have powers
to make appointment of coaches and other staff subject to such conditions as
may be prescribed;
(c) have powers
to check and inspect accounts and general working of the games and Associations
and the District City and Tehsil
Committees;
(d) submit the
annual report and the audited accounts together with balance sheet to the Board
for approval; and
(e) perform such
other functions as may be assigned to him by the Board, the Executive Committee
or the Chairman.

12. Power
and Functions.--(1)The Committee shall have the
powers to:--
(i) register the Divisional Sports
Organizations subject to such terms and conditions as may be prescribed;
(ii)
to make grants-in-aid to such sports organizations as
are registered with the Divisional Committee and the District Committee in the
Division;
(iii)
take such disciplinary action as may be necessary against any sport
organizations of the division, its office-bearers, or members as it deems fit
in the interest of the games and in order to maintain discipline;
(iv)
collect sports share in the income of the Local
Councils in accordance with policy instructions of the Government; and
(v)
see and ensure that the funds of the Divisional Sports
Committee and its subordinate organizations District and Tehsil
level are utilized exclusively for organization and promotion of sports and for
no other purpose.
(2)
The fund of Divisional Sports Committee shall include:--
(a)
annual grants-in-aid from the Board.
(b)
special grant-in-aid from the Board.
(c)
donations, etc; and
(d)
income from tournaments, matches, camps, stadia and other properties.
(3)
The Chairman, Divisional Sports Committee shall have the power to incur
expenditure on Sports in the Division in lien with the policy and objectives
laid down by the Board subject to such limits as may be prescribed.
(4)
The accounts of the Divisional Sports Committee shall be got audited in such a
manner as may be prescribed.
(5)
A meeting of the Divisional Sports Committee shall be held not less than once
in six months. The Chairman shall, however, be competent to call additional
meetings of the Committee.
(6)
For the meeting of the Committee, at least 1/3rd of the total membership shall form the
quorum.

STATEMENT OF OBEJCTS
AND REASONS
There is no legislation for establishment
of a Balochistan Sports Board as a result of which
difficulty is being experienced in regulating and development of sports in Balochistan. It is felt expedient to establish a Sports
Board in Balochistan.
An effort has been made for originating a Act to provide for establishment of a Sports Board in the province of Balochistan in
the ensuing session of the Balochistan Provincial
Assembly.
